summary: Frontend-only verification of safeBack regression sweep + Instant Dezider step-aware back + risk-gate modal width. All 4 primary acceptance criteria PASS. Verified 5/5 representative deep-linked screens (/tools/eg-advisor, /tools/solution-finder-list, /tools/values, /ai-wallet, /pricing) — top-left back arrow correctly lands on '/' (or the eg-advisor's custom EG-hub fallback) instead of dead-ending. In-flow back regression (Dashboard → Solution Box → tool → back → Solution Box) also works. Instant Dezider step-aware back returns Test2→Test1 correctly. Risk-gate modal renders as a centered card (width=440px, maxWidth=440px, alignSelf=center on a 1280-wide viewport) — NOT stretched. One MINOR finding only: the header Back button is z-ordered BEHIND the RN-web Modal overlay when the risk-gate is open, so tapping the visible header 'Back' while the modal is up does not reach handleBack(); only Esc (onRequestClose) and the 3 in-modal CTAs dismiss it. handleBack itself correctly checks showRiskGate first, so on native this works — only the web Modal portal causes the click to not reach the header. No crashes or red screens; safeBack import insertion did not break any of the sampled screens.

ui_bugs.component: test123/[id] risk-gate modal vs header Back button
ui_bugs.issue: On web preview, when id-risk-gate Modal is open, the page header 'Back' button is visible (modal is centered card, not full-screen) but is rendered behind RN-web's Modal portal/overlay, so tapping it does nothing. handleBack() does have the correct showRiskGate-first guard, but the click never reaches it on web. Esc and the 3 in-modal CTAs still close the modal correctly. Reference: /app/frontend/app/test123/[id].tsx:122-131, :661-695

action_items: Optional (LOW): If 'tapping the header Back arrow while id-risk-gate modal is up should also dismiss the modal' is a hard requirement, render the header Back inside the Modal as well, OR replace router.back-style handling with a global keyboard/back interceptor. Current behavior on web: header Back is visible but click is swallowed by Modal portal. Esc & in-modal CTAs work fine.

safeBack helper is clean (12 LoC) and the canGoBack check is defensive (typeof check + try/catch).
